title: AgreementTransitionReceipt
description: DRAFT — signed proof that the Runtime accepted and committed one legal transition. Its lifecycle is owned by the Audit plane, which builds and manages receipts from the Runtime's hash-chained transition-proof record. The runtime signature covers ONLY the immutable transition fields (schema, receiptId, dealId, commandId, commandHash, fromState, toState, revision, recordedAt); auditStatus and auditReceiptRef are Audit-owned lifecycle metadata OUTSIDE the signed bytes, so their later updates cannot invalidate the signature. Distinct from the Audit receipt it references: the transition receipt proves what the Runtime accepted; the Audit receipt proves the corresponding domain event reached the append-only Audit log. They MUST NOT be presented as the same guarantee.

commandId.description: Present when the transition was driven by a party command; absent on Runtime-driven transitions (chain observations, deadline expiries, auto-confirm), whose receipt-identity contract is a draft gap (spec §9.1).

commandHash.description: Hash of the accepted command; absent alongside commandId on Runtime-driven transitions.

auditStatus.description: Audit ingestion may still be pending when this receipt is returned — the proof package stays in_progress until the matching Audit event is durably appended.

auditReceiptRef.description: Reference to the matching Audit receipt once durably appended.

runtimeSignature.description: null is a VALID value and a visible non-guarantee: an unsigned receipt MUST NOT be presented as proof of anything (a mock or pre-signing deployment emits these). This is distinct from receipt: null, which means no receipt exists at all. When present, sig is a secp256k1-keccak-v1 signature by the Runtime's own key over the immutable transition fields only — see the schema description.

keyId.description: Canonical keyId: the Runtime's DID plus its key's thumbprint fragment, <did>#jkt:<16 lowercase hex> (spec §8). Names the specific secp256k1 key whose recovered address the sig must match.

sig.description: Recoverable secp256k1 ECDSA signature over keccak256(kite:a2a-agreement:receipt:v1 ‖ rfc8785(immutable receipt fields)), 0x-prefixed 65-byte r‖s‖v hex (profile secp256k1-keccak-v1).

agreementState.description: The engine's agreement states, UPPERCASE on the wire. Source of truth: fulfill-engine pkg/model/model.go. A SETTLEMENT_OBSERVED self-loop yields fromState == toState on a terminal state.
